training: Accepted teacher labels from new 30 paired mechanism catalog
development: Previously inspected corrected 16 cases; never holdout
candidate: Frozen pinned MiniLM mean pooling plus seven-way learned linear head, 512-token renderer and explicit freshness/change/graph features
selection: Highest complete development disposition agreement; first trial wins ties
next_if_insufficient: Record frozen-head result before a separately identified end-to-end candidate. Do not add development cases to training.
no_generalization_claim: Family IDs are disjoint; conceptual themes deliberately overlap and have not been independently adjudicated.
